stories.headline: Democrat Scott Colom unseats Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith in Mississippi Senate race

key_facts.fact: Democrat Scott Colom ousted Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith in a Mississippi Senate seat flip that Axios called historic.
key_facts.excerpt: Scott Colom ousts Cindy Hyde-Smith in historic Mississippi Senate flip

key_facts.fact: G1 reports Colom will be the first Black senator from Mississippi in about 150 years, after a turnaround result.
key_facts.excerpt: Em reviravolta, democrata vence no Mississippi e será o 1º senador negro do estado em 150 anos

key_facts.fact: The BBC described the result as a surprise victory for the Democratic Party.
key_facts.excerpt: Democrat Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate race in surprise victory for party

key_facts.fact: The Guardian called it a shocking win, and SCMP framed it within the US midterms as a historic Senate seat.
key_facts.excerpt: US midterms: Democrat Colom defeats Hyde-Smith in Mississippi to win historic Senate seat

stories.headline: Russia's ambassador to the US, Alexander Darchiev, dies suddenly at 66

key_facts.fact: Russia's ambassador to the United States, Alexander Darchiev, died at age 66.
key_facts.excerpt: Russia’s ambassador to the United States dies, aged 66

key_facts.fact: Russia's foreign ministry said he died suddenly.
key_facts.excerpt: Russia’s ambassador to the US dies ‘suddenly’, foreign ministry says

key_facts.fact: Darchiev had held the Washington post since March 2025, according to the Russian foreign ministry's confirmation of his death.
key_facts.excerpt: O Ministério das Relações Exteriores da Rússia confirmou o falecimento repentino de Alexander Darchiev, que ocupava o cargo de embaixador em Washington desde março de 2025.

key_facts.fact: The death came on the same day US-Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi ended and US envoys prepared to travel to Moscow; The New York Times and G1 ran obituaries and profiles.
key_facts.excerpt: Alexander Darchiev, Russia’s Ambassador to the U.S., Dies at 66

stories.headline: Spain holds first general strike in 14 years over housing crisis, weeks before elections

key_facts.fact: Spanish workers staged a general strike on Nov. 11, the country's first in 14 years, demanding solutions to the housing crisis.
key_facts.excerpt: Spain's first general strike in 14 years demands solutions to housing crisis

key_facts.fact: Strikers demanded action on high housing costs and lagging wages ahead of elections on Nov. 29.
key_facts.excerpt: Trabalhadores espanhóis paralisaram o país em 11 de novembro de 2026, exigindo medidas contra o alto custo da moradia e salários defasados antes das eleições de 29 de novembro.

key_facts.fact: The strike was backed by the government and criticized by the opposition, according to BBC Brasil.
key_facts.excerpt: 3 pontos para entender a primeira greve geral na Espanha em 14 anos, apoiada pelo governo e criticada pela oposição

key_facts.fact: WSJ framed cost of living as the central issue ahead of the elections; G1 reported clashes between protesters and police.
key_facts.excerpt: Spain Hit by General Strike as Cost of Living Takes Center Stage Ahead of Elections

stories.headline: Israeli strike on Gaza's Nasser Hospital kills at least six despite ceasefire

key_facts.excerpt: Strike on Gaza Hospital Kills at Least 6 and Injures 20, Rescuers Say

key_facts.fact: Gaza's civil defence agency attributed the strike to Israel and gave a toll of at least six dead.
key_facts.excerpt: Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital kills at least six, Gaza civil defence agency says

key_facts.fact: The Guardian reported that a surgeon was among the dead.

stories.headline: UK AI chip startup Fractile raises $720M Series C at a reported $7B valuation

key_facts.fact: London-based AI chip startup Fractile raised $720M from Thrive, Founders Fund and others, sources told the FT, at a $7B post-money valuation, up from about $1.1B in May.
key_facts.excerpt: London-based AI chip startup Fractile raised $720M from Thrive, Founders Fund, and others, sources say at a $7B post-money valuation, up from ~$1.1B in May (George Hammond/Financial Times)

key_facts.fact: Tech.eu reported that Lightspeed and Alphabet's CapitalG back the round, sized at more than £500M.
key_facts.excerpt: Lightspeed and Alphabet's CapitalG back Fractile in £500M plus funding round

key_facts.fact: Sifted confirmed the raise at £540M, a figure it had revealed first.
key_facts.excerpt: Fractile confirms £540m raise first revealed by Sifted

key_facts.fact: The Series C is meant to scale production of AI chips and secure fab capacity through 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: A Fractile captou US$ 720 milhões em rodada Série C, avaliada em mais de £ 5 bilhões, para escalar a produção de chips de IA e garantir capacidade fabril até 2028.
